---
title: "Managing variants"
lang: en
---
Variants store model inputs for a project. Save a reference before applying presets or changing a set of assumptions.

**Excel location:** [📁 Save Current Inputs / Variants]{.excel-menu .darkred}; project export and import are available under **klimaaktiv PEQ → Project Variants**.

::: {.excel-operation}
### Variant workflow
1. Set up and calculate a documented reference case.
2. Save the current inputs as a named variant.
3. Change a defined set of inputs and recalculate.
4. Save the changed state under a distinct name.
5. Compare the variants using the [comparison](comparison.qmd) or [Results](results.qmd).
:::

The training material distinguishes the input store (`IN`), the hourly simulation (`SIM2`) and result store (`OUT`). A project export stores project data for transfer between tool versions; see [Migration](migration.qmd).
